name: Halazepam
summary: A less common prescription benzodiazepine and derivative of Nordazepam. Also known as Paxipam, it is no longer prescribed in the USA. The drug is reported to have sedating, hypnotic and anxiolytic effects. Doses may induce amnesia and lowered inhibitions.

uses.text: Halazepam was used for the treatment of anxiety.

sideEffects.text: Adverse effects include drowsiness, confusion, dizziness, and sedation. Gastrointestinal side effects have also been reported including dry mouth and nausea.

pharmacology.en: It is a benzodiazepine that boosts the calming effect of GABA at GABAA receptors. Much of its action comes from its conversion in the liver to nordazepam.
pharmacology.zh: 它是一種苯二氮平類，可在 GABAA 受體增強 GABA 的鎮靜作用。它的作用大多來自在肝臟轉化成的去甲西泮。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它是一种苯二氮平类，可在 GABAA 受体增强 GABA 的镇静作用。它的作用大多来自在肝脏转化成的去甲西泮。

fact.en: Halazepam carries a trifluoroethyl group, a small chain capped with three fluorine atoms. The body strips it off, so much of its effect comes from nordazepam, the same active metabolite produced by diazepam.
fact.zh: Halazepam 帶有三氟乙基，也就是末端接了三個氟原子的短鏈。身體會把它切除，因此它的作用大多來自去甲西泮，而地西泮也會產生同樣的活性代謝物。
fact.zhHans: Halazepam 带有三氟乙基，也就是末端接了三个氟原子的短链。身体会把它切除，因此它的作用大多来自去甲西泮，而地西泮也会产生同样的活性代谢物。
